landing.heroDescription: Build your verified patient profile and manage clinic appointments with confidence. One connected system designed to make every hospital visit faster and easier.
landing.readyToBook: Ready to book your next visit?
landing.healthcareUnified: Patient pre-registration and appointment scheduling, unified
landing.healthcareDescription: We combine digital pre-registration with a modern appointment workflow to reduce delays and simplify hospital reception.
landing.benefit1Desc: Create a complete, verified patient identity with structured location, demographic, and emergency contact details before arriving at the hospital.
landing.benefit2Desc: Select a department and doctor, choose an available schedule, explain your symptoms, and review everything before confirming.
landing.benefit3Desc: Receive timely updates as your appointment moves through payment, check-in, consultation, laboratory, and completion.
landing.waitingDescription: Hospital reception teams often spend valuable time collecting patient information manually. DPAMS lets you securely provide important details from home so your clinical record is ready before arrival.
landing.geoVerificationDesc: Choose your region, district, and ward from complete frontend-managed Tanzania location data.
landing.emergencyNextOfKinDesc: Structured next-of-kin details help clinical teams respond safely during critical moments.
landing.automatedCompletenessDesc: Confirm that required patient information is complete before booking an appointment.
landing.instantAccessDesc: Unlock appointment scheduling as soon as your required profile information is complete.
landing.preRegisterSchedule: Pre-register and schedule your appointment in minutes
landing.noComplicatedForms: Complete your patient profile and schedule care without filling in complicated reception forms at the clinic.
landing.step1Desc: Register and complete your health, contact, next-of-kin, and Tanzania location information.
landing.step2Desc: Select a department, an available doctor and schedule, then provide your symptoms or reason for visiting.
landing.step3Desc: Review the appointment summary, confirm the details, and complete the required payment.
landing.step4Desc: Check in on the appointment date and receive updates through consultation, laboratory work, and completion.
landing.yourInfoSafe: Your health information is safe with us
landing.privacyDescription: We take your privacy seriously. Your medical information and personal data are protected using industry-standard security measures.
landing.faq1Question: Is this service free to use?
landing.faq1Answer: Yes. Creating an account and booking an appointment is free. You only pay for hospital services you receive.
landing.faq2Question: How do I know my appointment is confirmed?
landing.faq2Answer: You will receive a notification and can follow the appointment status from your dashboard.
landing.faq3Answer: Yes. You can cancel an eligible appointment or reschedule it using an available doctor schedule.
landing.faq4Question: What if I need help using the system?
landing.faq4Answer: Our support team is available during working hours. Call, email, or visit the help desk whenever you need assistance.
landing.assistanceDescription: Whether you need help booking, checking an appointment status, or using your patient profile, our support team is ready to assist.
landing.joinThousands: Join patients who are simplifying their healthcare journey with DPAMS.
landing.footerDescription: Making healthcare simpler and more predictable for every patient. Complete your profile, book care, and stay informed in one place.
landing.copyright: Built with care for patients everywhere.
